items.summary: Authorization bypass through a user-controlled key in Microsoft Entra Device Registration lets an unauthorized attacker elevate privileges over a network. Microsoft rates it the maximum CVSS 10.0, the most severe CVE published this week.
Kyverno 1.17.0 to 1.19.1 lets namespace tenants abuse NamespacedMutatingPolicy to overwrite resources in other namespaces, including Secrets and Deployments cluster-wide. Fixed in Kyverno 1.19.2.

The payever WooCommerce Gateway plugin for WordPress (up to 4.8.0) exposes unauthenticated API callbacks and writes an attacker-controlled file to the public uploads directory before validating its type, allowing unauthenticated remote code execution.

Craft CMS 4.x and 5.x contain an unauthenticated SQL injection flaw in the element search endpoint, where an unsanitized attribute parameter is concatenated into the query. Attackers can read and write the database, including setting the admin flag or overwriting password hashes. Fixed in 4.18.9 and 5.11.2.

Keycloak's SAML HTTP-Redirect binding processes percent-encoded parameter names (like %53AMLResponse) while signature verification only checks literal names, letting an attacker substitute a crafted unsigned SAML message. The flaw can lead to full account takeover of federated users.
